title: 污染 0.1% 的预训练数据，就能给 AI 智能体埋下洗不掉的后门
raw_text: 只污染 0.1% 的预训练数据，就能给一个 AI 智能体埋下后门。而且用完全干净的数据做微调和强化学习，也清不掉。 这是一篇论文的结论，标题叫《Agentic Backdoors via Pretraining Poisoning》，作者来自加州大学伯克利分校、伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校和 Anthropic，其中包括 Nicholas Carlini 和 Javier Rando。论文 ...
reason_zh: 伯克利、UIUC与Anthropic合作论文揭示仅污染0.1%预训练数据即可植入难清除的智能体后门，安全启示强。
summary_zh: 文章介绍论文《Agentic Backdoors via Pretraining Poisoning》，作者来自加州大学伯克利分校、伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校和Anthropic，包括Nicholas Carlini与Javier Rando。研究结论是：只需污染0.1%的预训练数据，就能给AI智能体埋下后门，而且即便后续用完全干净的数据进行微调和强化学习，也无法清除该后门。这一发现揭示了预训练阶段数据投毒的长期隐蔽风险，对智能体安全、数据供应链治理与模型对齐研究都具有重要警示意义。
title_zh: 污染0.1%的预训练数据，就能给AI智能体埋下洗不掉的后门

title: 瑞士发生五起 AI 智能体网络攻击，电力供水通信系统遭入侵
raw_text:
IT之家 11 月 26 日消息，据路透社报道，瑞士联邦网络安全局（BACS）周四通报，过去几天瑞士发生五起网络攻击，攻击者使用 AI 智能体针对企业以及关键基础设施运营方发起入侵。

IT之家注意到，该局在公告中表示，五起攻击里有四起攻击得手，相关系统遭到入侵。遭到攻击的对象包含三家关键基础设施运营主体，据瑞士公共广播公司 SRF 介绍，它们分别是电力、供水以及通信服务供应商。

瑞士联邦网络安全局没有透露攻击的幕后主体信息。机构建议相关企业落实防护手段，其中包括定期开展网络安全检测。
reason_zh: 首例AI智能体攻击关键基础设施的公开通报，安全从业者值得关注，但内容为快讯转述。
summary_zh: 瑞士联邦网络安全局（BACS）通报，过去几天瑞士发生五起网络攻击，攻击者使用 AI 智能体针对企业及关键基础设施运营方发起入侵，其中四起得手。受影响对象包括三家关键基础设施运营主体，据瑞士公共广播公司 SRF 介绍，分别为电力、供水与通信服务供应商。BACS 未披露攻击幕后主体信息，并建议相关企业采取防护措施。这是公开通报中较少见的由 AI 智能体实施、且成功入侵关键基础设施的案例，凸显智能体自动化攻击的现实风险。

title: Microsoft details how state-backed hackers use the ARTEX AI framework to automate cyberattacks
raw_text:
Microsoft has published the technical architecture of ARTEX, an AI framework in wide use since July 2026 that runs cyberattacks with specialized agents and almost no human involvement. State-backed groups from China and North Korea, along with criminal organizations, are already using the system. Microsoft recommends deception techniques like honeypots and faked success signals as defenses, but how long those will hold up against agents that learn and adapt remains an open question.

title: When Are Parallel Subagents Effective for Coding? An Empirical Study on Repository Construction
raw_text:
arXiv:2611.33893v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: LLM-based coding agents are increasingly used for long-horizon tasks such as building an entire program from a specification. Products like Codex and Claude Code let an agent delegate work to parallel subagents, multiplying run cost, yet it remains unclear whether and when delegation produces a better program. We compare a single agent with a main agent delegating to subagents on repository-construction tasks from NL2Repo and ProgramBench (which also provides an executable reference program). We compare scores at equal time and equal cost, run intervention experiments, and analyze fine-grained behavior. On randomly drawn tasks, parallel subagents raise hidden-test pass rates by only about 1 to 5 percentage points at up to 3.8x the cost of a single agent. Their gain is larger on hard tasks, where we find evidence of three mechanisms. Self-checking: with GPT-5.6 Sol, one sentence telling a single agent to probe the reference program first
reason_zh: 实证回答并行子智能体何时真能提升编码质量，对使用 Codex、Claude Code 的工程团队有直接参考价值。
summary_zh: 论文针对 Codex、Claude Code 等产品支持的并行子智能体委派机制做实证研究：主智能体把任务分派给多个并行子智能体，会成倍增加运行成本，但委派是否、以及在什么条件下能产出更好的程序仍不清楚。作者在从规格说明构建完整仓库的长程编码任务上，对比单智能体与主从多智能体配置，分析任务可分解性、子任务耦合度等因素对最终代码质量的影响，给出何时值得使用并行委派的经验结论。
title_zh: 并行子智能体何时对编码有效？面向仓库构建的实证研究

title: PLAICraft: Large-Scale Time-Aligned Vision-Speech-Action Dataset for Embodied AI
raw_text:
arXiv:2505.12707v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Advances in deep generative modeling have made it increasingly plausible to train human-level embodied agents. Yet progress has been limited by the absence of large-scale, real-time, multi-modal, and socially interactive datasets that reflect the sensory-motor complexity of natural environments. To address this, we present PLAICraft, a novel data collection platform and dataset capturing multiplayer Minecraft interactions across five time-aligned modalities: video, game output audio, microphone input audio, mouse, and keyboard actions. Each modality is logged with millisecond time precision, enabling the study of synchronous, embodied behaviour in a rich, open-ended world. The dataset comprises 5525 hours of interactive gameplay from more than 232 participants. Alongside the dataset, we provide an evaluation suite for benchmarking model capabilities in object recognition, spatial awareness, language grounding, and long-term mem
reason_zh: 发布大规模时间对齐的视觉-语音-动作具身数据集，填补多模态社交交互数据缺口，对具身智能研究有基础价值。
summary_zh: 论文发布 PLAICraft，一个面向具身 AI 的大规模时间对齐视觉-语音-动作数据集。深度生成模型的进展使训练类人具身智能体成为可能，但进展受限于缺少能反映自然环境中感知-运动复杂性的大规模、实时、多模态且具社交交互性的数据。PLAICraft 采集时间对齐的视觉、语音与动作信号，覆盖多人社交交互场景，为具身智能体的多模态感知与行为建模提供训练与评测基础。
title_zh: PLAICraft：面向具身 AI 的大规模时间对齐视觉-语音-动作数据集

title: Emilia2: A Large-Scale Dataset for Controllable Long-Form Speech Generation
raw_text:
arXiv:2611.13614v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Generating long-form speech requires models to keep content, speaker identity, turn-taking, and expressive style consistent over time. Yet most open training corpora contain examples lasting only tens of seconds and open long-form benchmarks cover at most two speakers per recording. We introduce Emilia2, a 229K-hour multilingual dataset for controllable long-form speech generation. From in-the-wild data, Emilia2 constructs short utterances, single-speaker long-form speech, and multi-speaker dialogues, preserving transcripts, speaker identities, pauses, and acoustic transitions. Examples longer than five minutes account for 50.0% of single-speaker long-form hours and 66.8% of dialogue hours. To support expressive control, Emilia2 provides natural language instructions for 4.77M examples and nonverbal-vocalization tags for 933K examples. reason_zh: 发布 22.9 万小时多语种长语音数据集，填补长时长、多说话人可控语音生成训练与评测的空白。
summary_zh: 论文指出，长时长语音生成要求模型在时间上保持内容、说话人身份、轮次转换与表达风格的一致性，但现有开源训练语料多为数十秒级样本，公开的长语音基准最多只覆盖两个说话人。为此作者推出 Emilia2，一个约 22.9 万小时的多语种数据集，面向可控长语音生成，用于支撑训练与评测，弥补长时长、多说话人场景下数据与基准的不足。
title_zh: Emilia2：面向可控长语音生成的大规模数据集

title: 381个AI直播冲刺证明P=NP！把GitHub干崩了

reason_zh: AI 集群尝试证明 P=NP 并形式化验证，极具话题性和启发性。

title: Nvidia stops AI GPU shipments to Southeast Asia amid purported China cloud access ban, report claims
raw_text: Data centers in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, and Indonesia are now required to obtain export licenses if they want to get their Nvidia AI GPUs delivered.
reason_zh: 英伟达对东南亚 GPU 出货设限，直接影响算力供应链，值得关注但为二手报道。
summary_zh: 据 Tom's Hardware 报道，英伟达已停止向东南亚地区发运 AI GPU，原因是相关数据中心可能被用于规避对中国的云访问限制。报道称，新加坡、马来西亚、泰国和印度尼西亚的数据中心现在需要获得出口许可证，才能接收英伟达 AI GPU 的交付。此举被视为美国出口管制向第三地转口渠道延伸的举措，可能影响东南亚算力租赁与云服务供给，并对依赖该地区算力资源的 AI 企业产生连锁影响。
title_zh: 报道称英伟达停止向东南亚发运 AI GPU，因中国云访问禁令
